params.title: BHV-certificeringen
params.description: BHV-gerelateerde certificeringen per medewerker: rol, geldigheid en organisatie-eenheid. Geen numerieke dekkingsnorm -- de Arbowet (art. 15) vraagt een RI&E-gebaseerde, kwalitatieve beoordeling.
params.note: bhv-organisatie (2026-07-17): coverage VISIBILITY, not a coverage formula (REQ-BHV-003/-004, design.md D2) -- this index lists who is currently certified, filterable/groupable by orgUnitId and rol, so HR/a safety officer can judge adequacy against their own RI&E. No red/green adequacy indicator, no computed ratio anywhere on this page.

params.title: BHV-certificering
params.note: bhv-organisatie (2026-07-17): plain dated-fact record, no x-openregister-lifecycle (design.md D4) -- a renewal is a new BhvCertificering object, not a status transition, so this page carries NO lifecycleActions widget (the OrgUnitDetail/OrgAssignmentDetail precedent for lifecycle-less schemas). The 'Certificering' data widget excludes employeeId/orgUnitId since Related already resolves and links both by name (the EmployeeDetail exclude convention). No stat/files/comms leaves -- a certification record has no numeric headline aggregate or document field. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
